registryEntry.label: Terminated User Account Disable Audit Evidence
evidence_commands: $d = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/directoryAudits?`$filter=activityDisplayName eq 'Disable account'&`$top=10&`$orderby=activityDateTime desc").value | Where-Object { $_ }); $s = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/directoryAudits?`$filter=activityDisplayName eq 'Revoke sign in sessions'&`$top=10&`$orderby=activityDateTime desc").value | Where-Object { $_ }); [pscustomobject]@{ count = $d.Count + $s.Count; disableAccount = $d.Count; revokeSessions = $s.Count; events = @(@($d) + @($s) | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ activityDisplayName = $_.activityDisplayName; activityDateTime = $_.activityDateTime; initiatedBy = $_.initiatedBy; targetResources = $_.targetResources } }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10

metadata.commandExecuted: [manual/evidence-only] Terminated User Account Disable Audit Evidence
